name: QuarticGluing.duplication_ordinate_numerator
statement: theorem duplication_ordinate_numerator {R : Type} [CommRing R] (x a b : R) : -8*(x^3+a*x+b)^2+12*x*(x^3+a*x+b)*(3*x^2+a)-(3*x^2+a)^3 = x^6+5*a*x^4+20*b*x^3-5*a^2*x^2-4*a*b*x-8*b^2-a^3

name: QuarticGluing.sum_kernel_projection_injective
statement: theorem sum_kernel_projection_injective {E F A : Type} [IntModule A] (e : E → A) (f : F → A) (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : E) (q r : F) (hq : e p+f q=0) (hr : e p+f r=0) : q=r

name: QuarticGluing.kernel_transport_bijective
statement: theorem kernel_transport_bijective {E F A E' F' A' : Type} (s : E → F → A) (t : E' → F' → A') (z : A) (w : A') (e : E → E') (f : F → F') (u : A → A') (he : Bijective e) (hf : Bijective f) (hu : Function.Injective u) (uz : u z=w) (comm : ∀ p q, u (s p q)=t (e p) (f q)) : Bijective (transport s t z w e f u uz comm)

name: QuarticGluing.quotient_kernel_saturated
statement: theorem quotient_kernel_saturated {M Q : Type} [IntModule M] [IntModule Q] (q : M → Q) (linear : ∀ n : Int, ∀ a, q (n • a)=n • q a) (torsionfree : ∀ n : Int, n≠0 → ∀ b : Q, n • b=0 → b=0) (n : Int) (hn : n≠0) (a : M) (ha : q (n • a)=0) : q a=0

name: QuarticGluing.saturated_equal_rational_span
statement: theorem saturated_equal_rational_span {M : Type} [IntModule M] (L W : M → Prop) (included : ∀ a, L a → W a) (saturated : ∀ a n, n≠(0 : Int) → L (n • a) → L a) (sameSpan : ∀ a, W a → ∃ n : Int, n≠0 ∧ L (n • a)) : ∀ a, L a ↔ W a
